_comment: Country-level economic indicators. `source_code` is the code in the source (World Bank WDI). `unit`: usd (published in USD millions), usd_pc (USD per person), people, pct. `scale`: "sequential" colors the map on one ramp from the lowest to the highest values (levels that are never negative, e.g. life expectancy) instead of diverging around zero. The World Bank and UNDP World aggregates are kept as WLD. `group`: how a group's value is formed from its members (as of each year): sum = add members' values (only when members with data hold >= 95% of the group's population), none = not computed for groups. Derived indicators are computed at publish time from others. `hidden` indicators are inputs only.

indicators.name: GDP
indicators.description: Gross domestic product, current US dollars

indicators.name: GDP, constant prices
indicators.description: Gross domestic product, constant 2015 US dollars (used for real growth)

indicators.name: GDP per capita
indicators.description: GDP divided by population, current US dollars

indicators.name: Real GDP growth
indicators.description: Annual change in GDP at constant prices

indicators.name: Unemployment
indicators.description: Unemployment, % of labour force (ILO modelled estimate)

indicators.name: FDI inflows
indicators.description: Foreign direct investment, net inflows, current US dollars

indicators.name: Current account balance
indicators.description: Current account balance, current US dollars

indicators.name: Trade in goods & services, % of GDP
indicators.description: Exports plus imports of goods and services as a share of GDP (national accounts)

indicators.name: Child mortality
indicators.description: Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births

indicators.name: Extreme poverty
indicators.description: Share of people living on less than $3.00 a day (2021 PPP); survey years only for most countries

indicators.name: Access to electricity
indicators.description: Share of the population with access to electricity

indicators.name: CO2 emissions
indicators.description: Carbon dioxide emissions excluding land use, million tonnes

indicators.name: CO2 emissions per person
indicators.description: Carbon dioxide emissions excluding land use, tonnes per person

indicators.name: Human Development Index
indicators.description: UNDP's summary of health, education and income, from 0 to 1
